subject: Re: CLAY kickoff — denoising our mobile UI datasets at scale
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing + the one big build item.

People: Kaia 50% (models — denoiser + the object typing model), Katya 40% (audit set + eval), Saoirse 40% and Wanjiru 40% (data engineering).

The build item: our internal screens differ enough from the public CLAY dataset that we need training data reflecting our own noise distribution. So: we're scoping and staffing a synthetic-data generation pipeline from scratch — there's nothing in the org we can reuse for this, so Saoirse and Wanjiru will build the noise-injection and screen-synthesis stages ourselves. Six weeks, starting Mar 2. It's the majority of the eng cost but it's also what makes the cleaning pass repeatable on every ingest.

Compute: light — 16 A100s best-effort on Titan covers training. No reservations.

Jelena
